args.sql_query:
WITH regional_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(total_sales) AS region_total_sales
  FROM region_product_sales_analysis
  GROUP BY region
),
ranked_regions AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    region_total_sales,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY region_total_sales DESC) AS region_rank
  FROM regional_totals
),
top_region AS (
  SELECT region, region_total_sales
  FROM ranked_regions
  WHERE region_rank = 1
),
product_contribution AS (
  SELECT 
    rps.region,
    rps.product_name,
    SUM(rps.total_sales) AS product_total_sales,
    tr.region_total_sales,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(rps.total_sales) / tr.region_total_sales, 2) AS contribution_pct
  FROM region_product_sales_analysis rps
  INNER JOIN top_region tr ON rps.region = tr.region
  GROUP BY rps.region, rps.product_name, tr.region_total_sales
)
SELECT 
  'Regional Rankings' AS analysis_type,
  region AS region_name,
  region_total_sales,
  NULL AS product_name,
  NULL AS product_sales,
  NULL AS contribution_pct
FROM ranked_regions

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'Top Region Products' AS analysis_type,
  region AS region_name,
  region_total_sales,
  product_name,
  product_total_sales AS product_sales,
  contribution_pct
FROM product_contribution
ORDER BY analysis_type, region_total_sales DESC, product_sales DESC

SELECT 
  region,
  SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales
FROM region_product_sales_analysis
WHERE region IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT 
  product_name,
  SUM(total_sales) AS product_sales
FROM region_product_sales_analysis
WHERE region = 'West'
GROUP BY product_name
ORDER BY product_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
